declarations.docstring: The trace-valued function of a finite free module action descends to a linear map from the quotient by the commutator submodule.
The descended trace map evaluated on the quotient class of an algebra element equals the trace-valued function evaluated on that element.
The trace-valued function of a finite free module action takes the same value on x times y and y times x.
The base-linear submodule of an algebra generated by multiplicative commutators.
The commutator submodule is contained in the kernel of the trace-valued function of every finite free module action.
